ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a 4×4 Karnaugh map. The column variables are labeled ab, and the column order is 00, 01, 11, 10; the row variables are labeled cd, and the row order is 00, 01, 11, 10. Reading each cell: in the cd=00 row, at ab=00 it is 1, at ab=01 it is X, at ab=11 it is X, and at ab=10 it is 1; in the cd=01 row, at ab=00 it is X, and at ab=10 it is 1; the cd=11 row is empty; in the cd=10 row, at ab=00 it is 1, and at ab=10 it is X. Reasoning: X is don't care, and can be treated as 1 when needed to enlarge groupings. First cover the 1 at cd=01, ab=10: using the left-right wraparound adjacency of columns ab=00 and ab=10, and the adjacency of rows cd=00 and cd=01, form a 2×2 group containing the four cells with cd=00/01 and ab=00/10; in this group, b=0 and c=0 remain unchanged, while a and d vary, so the term b'c' is obtained, namely \overline{b}\overline{c}. Then cover the remaining needed 1 at cd=10, ab=00: using the top-bottom wraparound adjacency of rows cd=00 and cd=10, and the left-right wraparound adjacency of columns ab=00 and ab=10, form another 2×2 group containing the four cells with cd=00/10 and ab=00/10; in this group, b=0 and d=0 remain unchanged, while a and c vary, so the term b'd' is obtained, namely \overline{b}\overline{d}. Combining the two necessary implicants, the minimum expression is \overline{b}\overline{d} + \overline{b}\overline{c}.

raw_record.question_text: What is the minimal form of the Karnaugh map shown in the image? Assume that \( X \) denotes a don't care term.

method.method_draft: First describe the map: it is a 4x4 K-map with ab labeling columns 00,01,11,10 and cd labeling rows 00,01,11,10; the visible 1s and Xs are read cell by cell. Treat useful X entries as don't-care 1s. Make the largest group covering the 1 at cd=01, ab=10 by grouping rows cd=00 and 01 with wraparound columns ab=00 and 10; this produces b'c'. Then cover the remaining needed 1 at cd=10, ab=00 by grouping rows cd=00 and 10 with the same wraparound columns ab=00 and 10; this produces b'd'. Combine the implicants to get the minimal expression b'd' + b'c'.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是一个 4×4 Karnaugh map。列变量标为 ab，列顺序为 00、01、11、10；行变量标为 cd，行顺序为 00、01、11、10。读出各格：cd=00 行在 ab=00 处为 1，ab=01 处为 X，ab=11 处为 X，ab=10 处为 1；cd=01 行在 ab=00 处为 X，ab=10 处为 1；cd=11 行为空；cd=10 行在 ab=00 处为 1，ab=10 处为 X。推理：X 是 don't care，可在需要时当作 1 来扩大分组。先覆盖 cd=01、ab=10 的 1：利用列 ab=00 与 ab=10 的左右环绕相邻性，以及行 cd=00 与 cd=01 的相邻性，组成一个 2×2 组，包含 cd=00/01 与 ab=00/10 的四格；该组中 b=0、c=0 保持不变，a 和 d 变化，因此得到项 b'c'，即 \overline{b}\overline{c}。再覆盖剩余需要的 cd=10、ab=00 的 1：利用行 cd=00 与 cd=10 的上下环绕相邻性，以及列 ab=00 与 ab=10 的左右环绕相邻性，组成另一个 2×2 组，包含 cd=00/10 与 ab=00/10 的四格；该组中 b=0、d=0 保持不变，a 和 c 变化，因此得到项 b'd'，即 \overline{b}\overline{d}。合并两个必要 implicants，最小式为 \overline{b}\overline{d} + \overline{b}\overline{c}。
